name: obsidian-tasks-vault
title: Obsidian Tasks (Vault)
description: Manage Obsidian tasks across your entire vault with surgical edits
author: santofer

commands.name: list-tasks
commands.title: List Tasks
commands.description: List all Obsidian tasks across your vault

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.description: Add a new task to Obsidian

commands.name: mark-done
commands.title: Mark Task Done
commands.description: Mark an Obsidian task as done

commands.name: menubar-item
commands.title: Toggle Menubar
commands.description: Show the first task in the menubar

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Obsidian Vault Path
preferences.description: Path to your Obsidian vault root directory

preferences.name: excludedFolders
preferences.title: Excluded Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folder names to skip (e.g., .obsidian,.git,.trash,Archive). Overridden by the setup wizard.

preferences.name: includedFolders
preferences.title: Included Folders (Whitelist)
preferences.description: If set, ONLY scan these folders. Leave empty to scan entire vault. Overridden by the setup wizard.

preferences.name: inboxFilePath
preferences.title: Inbox File
preferences.description: Relative path within vault for new tasks (e.g., Inbox.md). Leave empty to disable Add Task. Overridden by the setup wizard.

preferences.name: showCompletedTasks
preferences.title: Show Completed Tasks
preferences.description: Include completed tasks in the list view
preferences.label: Show completed tasks

preferences.name: showOnlyCurrent
preferences.title: Show Only Current Tasks
preferences.description: Show only tasks with a due or scheduled date that is today or earlier
preferences.label: Show only current tasks

preferences.name: showDueDate
preferences.title: Show Due Date in Menubar
preferences.description: Display the due date of tasks in the menubar
preferences.label: Show due date

preferences.name: menubarTaskCount
preferences.title: Show Task Count in Menubar
preferences.description: Show the number of tasks in the menubar
preferences.label: Show task count

preferences.name: showIcon
preferences.title: Show Icon in Menubar
preferences.description: Show the icon of tasks in the menubar
preferences.label: Show icon

preferences.name: maxMenubarDescriptionLength
preferences.title: Max Description Length
preferences.description: Maximum length of task description to show in menubar

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
